expr: (list (progn (defvar kg-dv-a 1 "A docstring.") (get 'kg-dv-a 'variable-documentation)) (progn (defvar kg-dv-b 2) (get 'kg-dv-b 'variable-documentation)) (progn (defconst kg-dc-a 3 "A const docstring.") (get 'kg-dc-a 'variable-documentation)) (progn (defvar kg-dv-c 1 "first") (defvar kg-dv-c 2 "second") (list kg-dv-c (get 'kg-dv-c 'variable-documentation))) (documentation-property 'kg-dv-a 'variable-documentation))
note: Phase 20: a `defvar'/`defconst' docstring lands on the symbol's `variable-documentation' property, an undocumented one leaves the property unset, and a re-`defvar' replaces the docstring while leaving the VALUE alone -- Emacs' measured rule, which kg's `defvar' already had for the value half.
